summary: Began a Svelte frontend audit of the Gizmo app: surveyed 76 .svelte files across apps/app and the packages/ui + packages/design libraries, launched three parallel Explore subagents (design tokens, accessibility, code quality), and started direct verification by opening the live dev server at localhost:5173. Identified concrete issues during the survey including duplicate components in packages/design vs packages/ui (Button/ConfirmDialog/SelectField), a missing parent role for an orphaned role="listitem" in SessionSidebar.svelte, and concentrated dead CSS hooks in workspace-picker.css and command-palette.css.
decisions: Will not touch the agent backend; running dev server and agents must not be disrupted
Subagents limited to breadth searching and summarizing or parallel implementation; fable is disallowed for subagents
Audit covers user experience and visual improvements of the Svelte frontend, not just code health
Use the live dev server at localhost:5173 (vite) for visual inspection alongside code reads
errors: Bash 'sleep 90; echo waited' was blocked by the tool runtime (sleep + follow-up chaining forbidden); subsequent until-loop pause timed out at 60s and was abandoned
Initial 'cd apps/app' bash failed (exit 28) because working directory differed; recovered by using absolute paths under /c/Users/mchan/projects/gizmo
